items.text: CE-6 (D5-5) not built: the subscription's share reached mid-run is still the hooks' plan-level budget pause (a budget card until the 1st), not a credential stop that waits or asks under the policy, and the allowance raise's change line is not built (both Wait lines of the share exist in askCardWords and are unit-tested). The share is held at every pick (CE-2), so a task's next pick waits and no money passes it. Needs the executor's budget-stop branch turned into a credential stop and a composed SDK test with a tiny allowance (ADR 0120's consequences name it).

CE-10: background jobs are not marked 'not done for the period' after a held call, and nothing logs it in one line. A held batch pick waits and a grant never covers batch (credential-policy.test.ts), so nothing is spent; whether calibration and the model watch try again next tick is not verified.
CE-1's one-time Update on homes with both credentials and nothing chosen ('Chat, planning and reviews now use your Claude subscription first, like your tasks ...'): not built (the spec allowed it).

CE-5's composed repository case (the work-in-progress commit under the continuing run's commit on the task's branch) is not built: the composed world's scripted Claude Code writes no file through the SDK driver's tools. The brief is covered at the model-facing boundary. Live check 4's LC-C23 is now its only check (folded there).

syncAskAnswers writes the grant, calls onGrant, then marks the card applied, not atomically: a crash in between could start a second continuation after a restart. One transaction, or onGrant idempotent per card, with a restart case.
onGrant readmits every ready task of a project with a running session, not only the tasks that waited for the stop.

compose's credentialHold reads human.timezone and monthly_cap_usd_micro as captured at compose time, not at each call: a monthly cap the person lowers, or a new zone, reaches the hold only after a restart. Check first whether the router's key_month stop reads the cap fresh at each pick; if it does not, this is major (a cap could be passed).
The router falls back to Date.now() when RouteContext.nowMs is absent (AGENTS.md: time goes through a Clock). Today's callers pass nowMs; make it required.

The concurrent-refusal test calls RouterTaskBilling.refuse twice; there is no case where a task run and a chat call meet the refusal at the same moment through the composed runtime (cred-world.ts can build it).
The intake card still says 'milestone(s)', 'task(s)' and 'doc(s)' (packages/runtime/src/intake.ts about :1476; C4b-left-2 fixed only 'a first-session plan of N tasks' beside it).

The project status line's Cancel and Continue show their explanation only as a tooltip; the bar's and Working now's Cancel show it beside the button (design section 3). While a session waits the Overview already states the fact four times with three Cancel buttons, which is heavy at 375 px (/tmp/frbench/review-d1109-run-visible/steps/05-rv3-home-while-it-waits-375.png). Not decided now: LC-C31 looks at the waiting Overview at both widths first, then the session lead decides (for example: the status line keeps the fact and drops its own Cancel while the bar shows it).

Two wordings of one fact (design section 5 rule 10): on Home and the Overview a running project's status line says 'Working on "Create index.html" (0 of 7 done)' beside the bar's 'Quote page · the coder works on "Create index.html"' (/tmp/frbench/fix-d1109-run-visible-after-steps/01-after-home-while-running.png); the session page says 'Current task: Choosing the next task…' while the bar says 'the critic checks "X"'.
The Overview says 'Last result: No session yet.' while the project's first session runs (/tmp/frbench/fix-d1109-run-visible-after-steps/08-after-stop-menu-open.png).

Stopping the critic's monthly check (Stop now or Stop all) aborts its run and the job records it as failed; its notification reads as a failed calibration, not as stopped by the person (packages/runtime/src/jobs).

After Cancel on a waiting session, chat's project facts (packages/runtime/src/conversation/project-facts.ts) and the typed 'summary' command (packages/commands/src/commands/summary.ts:79) still read the stored last result as written, so chat can repeat '...; then your session goes on.'. run-indicator.ts resultAfterWait(store, projectId, since, text) is the one rule (daemon-only; the commands package needs it through a port).

A calibration (fr jobs calibrate) or a session that a CLI one-shot starts beside a running daemon shows on GET /running (shared store) but sends no run.changed: the bar learns it only at a reload or reconnect.
While a start is queued behind another project's session, that project's header still offers 'Start session'; pressing it again asks for one more start (the status line offers nothing then).

scripts/desktop-window-check.mjs passes trivially when the session has already ended, and reads document.title, not the native window title (state::window_title / set_main_title are covered only by Rust unit tests). Make it fail when no running state was seen; the native title and the tray stay for the owner's install walk.

docs/maintainers/runtime.md says run.changed is poked by 'the wait list'; compose pokes it on session and project events, the scheduler's requestStart and cancelPending, and the calibration job's onRowChanged.
The real-daemon life-cycle case does not assert 'plans the session' during a live session (only through the restart ghost row).

Bench BEFORE walks: d1109-cred-engine made none (the code was changed first; the before behaviour is shown by the tests that failed before, e.g. billing-order 'From the API.' with nothing chosen); d1109-run-visible's ran on the base exported with git archive, not on a worktree branch. Accepted.

The UI's unit suite runs in Node, so a browser-only failure (a value import that reaches a Node module) blanked every page while vitest stayed green during the fix; apps/ui/test/browser-imports.test.ts now guards the workspace packages, and Playwright with the real Vite build runs at every merge (it did at C5's). Accepted as is; keep Playwright in every merge's validation.
The session log line written at the time of a wait keeps '...; then your session goes on.' after Cancel: a timestamped record of what was promised then, not a promise now. Accepted.

Not walked on a real desktop: the tray dot, tooltip and menu's first item, the native window title, the critic's monthly check on the bar (nothing on a running daemon can start it) and a working row past 49 steps (the stand-in's tasks stop at 30 parts). Covered by cargo tests, run-indicator.test.tsx and unit cases with 60 and 120 steps; the owner's install walk covers the tray and title (U-096).

changelog_update_log_lines: One credential choice for every call: until you pick one, chat, planning, reviews, the task check and the jobs use your Claude subscription first, like your tasks (the owner's answer 4).

When your rule says wait, nothing moves to the API key; under 'then ask me' one card asks whether your API key does the work until the subscription is back, and the app says a card waits only while it is in the Inbox.
A refused key or sign-in gets no further request until you save a new one, the model list included.
A task that its credential stopped is finished from where it stopped, not started again.

A running session shows on every page, in Talk, in the tray and in the window title; a session that waits says when it goes on, with Cancel. A start that waits behind another session shows on its project at once; after Cancel nothing says a session goes on by itself; the critic's monthly check shows on the bar while it runs.
